build_kernel_density_model: build a KernelDensity model with gaussian kernel and fixed bandwidth to estimate data density
fit_kernel_density: fit a KernelDensity model on training data with optional sample weights
score_samples_density: score samples to compute the log-likelihood of each sample under the fitted density model
score_total_log_likelihood: score the total log-likelihood of all samples under the fitted kernel density model
sample_random_points: generate random samples from a fitted gaussian or tophat kernel density model
